sections_en.text: Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Procedure: Replacing the coolers due to leakage and blockage in the cooling water inlet pipes of the cooler
Introduction
This document outlines the steps for replacing the generator air coolers, 3 coolers out of a total of 4 coolers
Technical Specifications of the Generator Air Coolers
Generator air cooler of Air water cross flow type, number of tubes 140 tubes, number of passes 8
Inner diameter 22 mm and outer diameter 24 mm, tube length 300 mm, finned
Air inlet temperature (65), air outlet temperature (40), test pressure 10 kg/cm2
Water flow rate 106 m3/hour
Water inlet temperature (35), water outlet temperature (42), test pressure 3 kg/cm2

Safety Precautions
Tools and Equipment Used
Occupational safety and health equipment
Open-end wrench set from 19 to 27 mm
Winch, forklift and jack, special fixture for supports and slides
Wooden wedges, plugs, rubber gaskets and a water hose, with silicone available

sections_en.text: Procedures to be Carried Out
Preparations
Shutdown of the generating unit on whose air coolers the work is being carried out
Prepare the supports and slides
Prepare the winch for lowering the air coolers
Dismantle the water inlet and outlet flanges of the cooler after closing the valves
Dismantle the cooler cover, test the air coolers to be installed
